BDM is developed openly and incrementally. This page tracks what is not done yet, so that nothing has to pretend.

## Being designed

- **Models**—how inferences about agents are stored and versioned ([draft notes](/spec/models/index.qmd)).
- **Multi-sensor and multi-agent studies**—how collaborative, VR, and multi-sensor recordings are represented.
- **Extensions**—the extensions listed on the [Extensions](/spec/extensions/index.qmd) page (custom tests, video games, compression, task EEG, resting state) are described but not yet specified.

## Planned guides

Several how-to guides are planned but not yet written. If one of these would help you, [open an issue](https://github.com/behaverse/data-model/issues/new) to help us prioritize:

multi-task studies · longitudinal and test–retest studies · multi-agent datasets · dataset validation · combining datasets · compatible datasets · AI agents on BDM data, including exposing datasets to language models through the [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io)

## Deliberately out of scope (for now)

- A style validator for naming conventions (the conventions are prose-first).
- A BDM-defined timeseries *payload* format: the [timeseries schema](/spec/timeseries/index.qmd) specifies the metadata sidecar, while the payload itself stays in a domain-appropriate format (EDF, Parquet, CSV, …).
